questions.q: On the axis of an electric dipole, far from the dipole, how does the field strength depend on the distance?
a: it does not depend on distance

Which statement about the net force $F$ and the torque $\tau$ on a dipole in a uniform electric field is correct?
questions.e: The forces are equal and opposite; the torque is $\vec p\times\vec E$.

questions.q: At what distance from the center along the axis of a uniformly charged ring of radius $R$ is the electric field strength maximum?
questions.e: $E\propto z/(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}$; setting the derivative to zero gives $z=R/\sqrt2$.

questions.q: Charges $+q$ sit at three corners of a square of side $a$, and $-q$ sits at the fourth. The magnitude of the electric field at the center of the square is
questions.e: The field of four $+q$ charges is zero; treating $-q$ as $+q-2q$ gives $E=k\cdot2q/(a^2/2)=4kq/a^2$, pointing toward the $-q$ charge.
